gate: Every observed input count equals the fixture width in both implementations; all sixteen SDK output counts and Rust tap-active flags equal one; every output value equals the fixture and the other implementation in exact f32 bits, including signed zero; every row finite; no tolerances, exclusions, alignment or fitted acceptance
lifecycle: Fresh graph/class per row; Rust verifies initial observed count zero and processes two frames to settle one cable. SDK verifies initial lastChannels zero. Adoption, bypass, Initialize, rate changes, allocation and callback lifecycle are qualified separately by Core and host tests.
inactive_input_protocol: All sixteen protocol values are finite and within +/-16 V; lanes at or above input width are positive zero. Both adapters reject nonzero or negative-zero inactive protocol padding. This is a legal zero-padded Engine fixture matrix, not a raw-padding injection test.
raw_slot_diagnostics: Separate frozen raw phase covers every width with four rotations of signed zero, finite extrema, infinity, NaN payloads and normal/subnormal storage; inactive slots are intentionally poisoned. Core unit tests additionally cover raw copying.
sdk_output_connection_adapter: Mark all sixteen SDK output ports connected with channels=1 before calling the actual class, matching Rack Engine.cpp connected-output bookkeeping. Adapter does not derive or replace output voltages.
rust_output_count_adapter: Each public resolved channel-zero tap reports its actual active flag and value. Split's one-channel-per-output shape is independently asserted by Core tests; this probe adds no production test API.
raw_gate: Every raw output slot exact u32 bits against both implementations and independent input bits; SDK and production output channels exactly one; observed input count equals declared width; initial count zero. No float parsing, NaN equality, clipping, exclusions or arithmetic in this phase.
raw_method: Actual pinned SDK Split class versus exact private production split.rs included by path in the example executable with public host types re-exported. Separate --raw mode injects bit-defined diagnostic storage directly. It bypasses public Engine/cables and is not a claim of legal Rack or OpenPatch producer/cable behavior.
